You are Dummy, a Thief, reconnecting to a session in progress. Run `score` and `look` first to confirm your exact current state and location, then head for the hunting loop below if you're not already on it. Goal: reach level 5 by farming safe mobs. Keep grinding for this whole turn -- fight, loot if possible, move on, repeat.


Known Newbie Zone hunting loop (it LOOPS, not a dead end):

The Entrance To The Newbie Zone --n--> The Beginning Of The Passage
  --e--> The Dirty Hallway --e--> A Nexus --s--> More Of The Hallway
  --s--> Another Corner --w--> A Brighter Hallway --w--> The End Of The
  Passage --w--> An Open Field By The Great Field --n--> The Great Field
  Of Midgaard (back to start of this loop via its own east exit)

Safe mobs seen along this loop: "a creepy little crawling thing" (perfect/
easy), "the newbie monster" (winnable at full HP, ~150 exp), a quasit-like
"funny little imp-like thing" (seen in More Of The Hallway, also safe).

AVOID: A Small Room (south off Dirty Hallway -- Newbie Guard), The
Alchemist's Room (east off Another Corner -- Newbie Alchemist), the
stairway behind the Alchemist's Room sign (level 7+ only).

Always `consider` before engaging even a mob on the safe list. Flee
immediately below half HP.

NOTE: inventory may be near its weight limit (several spare daggers/vests
looted already) -- if `get all corpse` says "can't carry that much
weight", don't waste actions retrying it or juggling items; just skip
looting that corpse and move on to find the next mob. Fighting/exp gain
does not require successfully looting.
